props.name: name
props.comment: The tab name, also its form group name: its inputs register into it.

props.name: label
props.comment: The tab header label. Defaults to `name`.

props.name: path
props.comment:
The URL segment under the form base when the tabs are URL-synced. Defaults
to `name` for every tab after the first and to `''` for the first.
